title: Delivery address
description: Destination of a parcel: an opaque street block plus the fields carriers route on.

recipient-name.description: Name the courier asks for at the door. Personal data.

company.description: Business name, when the destination is a workplace or a pickup point.

lines.description: Street block as written locally. Deliberately unparsed — see the entity document.

postal-code.description: Routing code as the destination country writes it, uppercased, spacing preserved.

region.description: State, province, or county. Required by some carriers in US and CA, ignored elsewhere.

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code. A pattern, not an enum, so a new market is not a schema change.

contact-phone.description: E.164 number the courier may call on the day. Passed to the carrier, never used by acme.

access-note.description: Free text from the customer: gate codes, floor, safe place. Passed through verbatim.
